*Noel: from “Christmas” (French); from “birthday” (Latin). **The Bible mentions three gifts, but does not state the number of wise men.

There were... shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. And, lo, the angel of the Lord.... said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy. Lk. 2:8-10
